name: ogbn_products_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

The paper specifies a tanh-diffusion incumbent but does not provide the products width, horizon or all deployment details. T=16, width 64, query size 4096 and within-split allocation are practical reconstruction choices. This generic profile uses the fixed loaded graph and exact remaining tails. It does not reproduce the paper's unspecified products corruption mixture or claim its fast tube timing.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
